title: Knight of the Mystic Pond
description: A purple armored knight stands in a glowing pond with koi fish, extending one hand toward the water as golden light swirls around it. The scene features a green spiral staircase lined with vibrant blue and purple flowers leading into the pond, set against a dramatic, colorful cosmic sky with swirling clouds, aurora, and multiple celestial bodies.
prompt: A majestic knight in ornate purple armor standing inside a circular pond filled with orange and white koi fish, one hand extended creating glowing ripples on the water. A green spiral staircase adorned with large blue and purple flowers descends into the pond. Dramatic swirling cosmic sky with vibrant orange clouds, green aurora, and multiple glowing moons and planets. Surreal fantasy scene with painterly brushwork and vibrant color contrasts.
